findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Command injection via subprocess
 * @description Using subprocess with shell=True or unsanitized input can lead to command injection
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/command-injection-setuptools
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    // subprocess.call/run/Popen with shell=True
    call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "run", "Popen", "check_call", "check_output"]).getACall() and
    call.getArgByName("shell").asExpr().(BooleanLiteral).booleanValue() = true
  ) or
  (
    // os.system calls
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("system").getACall()
  ) or
  (
    // os.popen calls
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("popen").getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe command execution that could allow command injection."
findings.hypothesis: Command injection through subprocess calls with shell=True or unsanitized user input

message.text: Potentially unsafe command execution that could allow command injection.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe archive extraction
 * @description Extracting archives without validating member paths can lead to arbitrary file writes
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-archive-extraction
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-022
 *        external/cwe/cwe-059
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    // zipfile extraction
    call = API::moduleImport("zipfile").getMember("ZipFile").getReturn().getMember(["extract", "extractall"]).getACall() or
    // tarfile extraction
    call = API::moduleImport("tarfile").getMember(["open", "TarFile"]).getReturn().getMember(["extract", "extractall"]).getACall() or
    // backports.tarfile extraction
    call = API::moduleImport("backports").getMember("tarfile").getMember(["open", "TarFile"]).getReturn().getMember(["extract", "extractall"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Archive extraction operation that may be vulnerable to path traversal attacks."
findings.hypothesis: Arbitrary file write via unsafe archive extraction without path validation

message.text: Archive extraction operation that may be vulnerable to path traversal attacks.

 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember("request").getMember(["urlopen", "urlretrieve", "Request"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember(["urlopen", "urlretrieve"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("urllib2").getMember(["urlopen", "urlretrieve", "Request"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("requests").getMember(["get", "post", "put", "delete", "request", "head", "options"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("httplib").getMember(["HTTPConnection", "HTTPSConnection"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("http").getMember("client").getMember(["HTTPConnection", "HTTPSConnection"]).getACall()
  )

findings.hypothesis: HTTP requests with potentially user-controlled URLs could lead to SSRF attacks
